desc: THE K6XS IS AN EXTRA SMALL, ULTRA-LIGHTWEIGHT REVOLVER with all the features of its larger framed sibling the K6s. The K6xs uses the same lightweight, non-stacking trigger system from the K6s. Also features a fluted glass-bead finish cylinder and barrel slot cut to further lighten the K6xs for the perfect carry weight. The big news for Kimber's K6s line is the addition of the K6xs. Not only is it the lightest K6s ever, it offers something others in its category don't: six-round capacity. Built specifically for concealed carry and chambered in .38 SPL +P, the aluminum alloy frame and fluted cylinder keep the revolver's total weight under a pound (15.9 ounces). The K6xs wears a silver KimPro II finish on the frame and a glass-bead finish on the 2-inch, stainless-steel barrel. The Hogue rubber Cobblestone grips with finger grooves make it comfortable to shoot.
